title: Why You Must Choose Your Regrets 🤔 #shorts
description:
Three Manhattans deep at 2 AM, a late-night revelation from Douglas Murray sparked a year-long realization: because you can never split-test reality, every single decision inherently locks you into an open loop. Regret isn't a symptom of failure, but an unavoidable opportunity cost of existence—meaning your only real choice is deciding which regret you are willing to bear. ⚡
